description: This Java class implements the EdqsStatsService interface, providing metrics and statistics reporting for the EDQS component within the Thingsboard platform. It manages counters, timers, and gauges related to EDQS operations, including query timings and object counts.

classes.name: DefaultEdqsStatsService
classes.description: Service class providing statistics and metrics for EDQS operations, including query timings and object counts.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes gauges for string pool size, byte pool size, and tenant repositories.

methods.name: reportAdded
methods.description: Increments object count gauge for a specific ObjectType.

methods.name: reportRemoved
methods.description: Decrements object count gauge for a specific ObjectType.

methods.name: reportEntityDataQuery
methods.description: Records timing for an EntityDataQuery and checks for slow query.

methods.name: reportEntityCountQuery
methods.description: Records timing for an EntityCountQuery and checks for slow query.

methods.name: reportEdqsDataQuery
methods.description: Records timing for an EDQS data query.

methods.name: reportEdqsCountQuery
methods.description: Records timing for an EDQS count query.

methods.name: checkTiming
methods.description: Logs whether a query was executed within the slow query threshold.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a StatsTimer by name.

methods.name: getCounter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a StatsCounter by name.

methods.name: getObjectGauge
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an AtomicInteger gauge for ObjectType.
